groups.label: Planned
groups.description: Not started yet: new, being researched, scheduled or kept for later.

groups.label: In progress
groups.description: Work is under way, waiting for an answer, accepted with follow-up work, or paused.

groups.label: Done
groups.description: Finished: published, received in full, or completed.

groups.label: Closed
groups.description: Ended without being done: rejected, dropped, not eligible, expired or no answer.

statuses.label: New
statuses.description: Just added. Nobody has looked at it properly yet.

statuses.label: Researching
statuses.description: You are checking fit, rules, eligibility or details.

statuses.label: Scheduled
statuses.description: You decided to go for it and it has a next action date.

statuses.label: Later
statuses.description: A good fit, but not now: it opens later, the next cohort, worth a second look.

statuses.label: Preparing
statuses.description: You are working on it: drafting the post, application, pitch or documents.

statuses.label: In contact
statuses.description: You reached out or you are in a conversation.

statuses.label: Submitted
statuses.description: You did your part (applied, posted, pitched, sent). Waiting for their answer.

statuses.label: Interview / pitch
statuses.description: They shortlisted you: an interview, a pitch or a demo is planned or done.

statuses.label: Due diligence
statuses.description: They are checking you in depth: documents, references, legal or financial review.

statuses.label: Negotiating
statuses.description: Terms are on the table and being discussed.

statuses.label: Won
statuses.description: They said yes: accepted, approved, awarded or committed. Follow-up work comes next.

statuses.label: Active
statuses.description: You take part and it is still running: a program, payments still coming, a recurring activity.

statuses.label: Blocked
statuses.description: You cannot continue until something else happens: a document, a reply, a decision.

statuses.label: On hold
statuses.description: Paused for now; you or they will pick it up again.

statuses.label: Published
statuses.description: Your listing, post, article or launch is live.

statuses.label: Received
statuses.description: The money or benefit arrived in full.

statuses.label: Completed
statuses.description: Finished from start to end.

statuses.label: Rejected
statuses.description: They said no.

statuses.label: Not pursuing
statuses.description: You decided to stop, withdrew or cancelled.

statuses.label: Not eligible
statuses.description: You do not meet the requirements, or it does not apply to you.

statuses.label: Expired
statuses.description: The deadline passed or the offer closed before you finished.

statuses.label: No response
statuses.description: No answer after your follow-ups.

campaignStatuses.label: Paused
campaignStatuses.description: Stopped for now, to be picked up again.

campaignStatuses.label: Archived
campaignStatuses.description: Kept for reference, no longer shown in active lists.
